001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007import java.math.BigInteger;
008
009@HistoryLogProps(
010    opCode = 279,
011    displayName = "Basal Delivery",
012    internalName = "LID_BASAL_DELIVERY",
013    usedByTidepool = true
014)
015public class BasalDeliveryHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
016    
017    private int commandedRateSource;
018    private int basalDeliveryFlags;
019    private int commandedRate;
020    private int profileBasalRate;
021    private int algorithmRate;
022    private int tempRate;
023    
024    public BasalDeliveryHistoryLog() {}
025    public BasalDeliveryHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int commandedRateSource, int basalDeliveryFlags, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
026        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
027        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, commandedRateSource, basalDeliveryFlags, commandedRate, profileBasalRate, algorithmRate, tempRate);
028        this.commandedRateSource = commandedRateSource;
029        this.basalDeliveryFlags = basalDeliveryFlags;
030        this.commandedRate = commandedRate;
031        this.profileBasalRate = profileBasalRate;
032        this.algorithmRate = algorithmRate;
033        this.tempRate = tempRate;
034        
035    }
036
037    public BasalDeliveryHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int commandedRateSource, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
038        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, commandedRateSource, 0, commandedRate, profileBasalRate, algorithmRate, tempRate);
039    }
040
041    public BasalDeliveryHistoryLog(int commandedRateSource, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
042        this(0, 0, commandedRateSource, commandedRate, profileBasalRate, algorithmRate, tempRate);
043    }
044
045    public int typeId() {
046        return 279;
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * <table border="1">
051     * <caption>Parsed fields for BasalDeliveryHistoryLog:</caption>
052     * <tr><td><code>commandedRateSource</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>basalDeliveryFlags</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>commandedRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>profileBasalRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>algorithmRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>tempRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
058     * </table>
059     */
060    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
061        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
062        this.cargo = raw;
063        parseBase(raw);
064        this.commandedRateSource = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
065        this.basalDeliveryFlags = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
066        this.commandedRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
067        this.profileBasalRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
068        this.algorithmRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
069        this.tempRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
070        
071    }
072
073    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int commandedRateSource, int basalDeliveryFlags, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
074        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
075            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(279, 0), // 279 = 256 + 23 (byte1 must be 1, not 0)
076            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
077            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
078            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(commandedRateSource),
079            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(basalDeliveryFlags),
080            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(commandedRate),
081            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(profileBasalRate), 
082            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(algorithmRate), 
083            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(tempRate)));
084    }
085
086    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int commandedRateSource, int commandedRate, int profileBasalRate, int algorithmRate, int tempRate) {
087        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, commandedRateSource, 0, commandedRate, profileBasalRate, algorithmRate, tempRate);
088    }
089
090    public int getCommandedRateSource() {
091        return commandedRateSource;
092    }
093
094    /**
095     * Raw value of bytes 12-13. Tandem's export does not name this field, so it is exposed as-is.
096     *
097     * <p>Only the values 0 and 3 have been observed, across roughly 49k records in two captures.
098     * 3 is written when any rate field changed versus the previous record, or when a
099     * TempRateActivated / TempRateCompleted / PumpingSuspended / PumpingResumed occurred in the
100     * 5-minute interval, and in nearly every record written while suspended. 0 is written for
101     * steady-state delivery. It is not a temp-rate indicator: it reads 0 in most records with an
102     * active temp rate. The meaning of the two individual bits is unknown; they have never been
103     * seen set independently. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/77.
104     */
105    public int getBasalDeliveryFlags() {
106        return basalDeliveryFlags;
107    }
108    public int getCommandedRate() {
109        return commandedRate;
110    }
111    public int getProfileBasalRate() {
112        return profileBasalRate;
113    }
114    public int getAlgorithmRate() {
115        return algorithmRate;
116    }
117    public int getTempRate() {
118        return tempRate;
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * Source of {@code commandedRate} (bytes 10-11).
123     *
124     * <p>Values 0, 1 and 2 are confirmed on the wire in a Control-IQ-off capture: for 2,
125     * {@code commandedRate == tempRate} in 768/768 records; for 0, the pump was suspended with
126     * {@code commandedRate} 0 and {@code tempRate}/{@code algorithmRate} both 0xFFFF in 20/20
127     * records; for 1, {@code commandedRate == profileBasalRate} in 10/10 records. 3 was observed
128     * in an earlier Control-IQ capture, where it predicted {@code algorithmRate != 0xFFFF}.
129     * 4 comes from Tandem's export value map and has not yet been observed.
130     * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/77.
131     */
132    public enum CommandedRateSource {
133        SUSPENDED(0),
134        PROFILE(1),
135        TEMP_RATE(2),
136        ALGORITHM(3),
137        TEMP_RATE_AND_ALGORITHM(4),
138        ;
139
140        private int id;
141        CommandedRateSource(int id) {
142            this.id = id;
143        }
144        public int id() {
145            return id;
146        }
147        public static CommandedRateSource fromId(int id) {
148            for (CommandedRateSource s : values()) {
149                if (s.id == id) return s;
150            }
151            return null;
152        }
153    }
154
155    /**
156     * @return the {@link CommandedRateSource} for {@code commandedRateSource}, or null if unknown
157     */
158    public CommandedRateSource getCommandedRateSourceEnum() {
159        return CommandedRateSource.fromId(commandedRateSource);
160    }
161    
162}
